dashboard.label: SOC Lab - 15 Scenario Campaign Overview
dashboard.description: Unified dashboard covering all 15 simulated attack scenarios (Insider Threat through Timestomping), mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Built by Jimil Joshi.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 (Process_Command_Line="*insider*" OR Process_Command_Line="*vssadmin*" OR Process_Command_Line="*wmic*" OR Process_Command_Line="*nslookup*c2-checkin*" OR Process_Command_Line="*certutil*urlcache*" OR Process_Command_Line="*mshta*" OR Process_Command_Line="*rundll32*" OR Process_Command_Line="*regsvr32*" OR Process_Command_Line="*CurrentVersion\\Run*" OR Process_Command_Line="*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Process_Command_Line="*advfirewall*" OR Process_Command_Line="*lsass*" OR Process_Command_Line="*setspn*" OR Process_Command_Line="*Rubeus*" OR Process_Command_Line="*KerberosRequestorSecurityToken*" OR Process_Command_Line="*MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachine*" OR Process_Command_Line="*Get-Clipboard*" OR Process_Command_Line="*CopyFromScreen*" OR Process_Command_Line="*checkin*" OR Process_Command_Line="*CreationTime*LastWriteTime*") NOT (Process_Command_Line="*PcaSvc.dll*" OR Process_Command_Line="*AppXDeploymentExtensions*" OR Process_Command_Line="*SHCreateLocalServerRunDll*") | stats count

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 NOT (Process_Command_Line="*PcaSvc.dll*" OR Process_Command_Line="*AppXDeploymentExtensions*" OR Process_Command_Line="*SHCreateLocalServerRunDll*") | eval scenario=case( match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)insider"), "01 Insider Threat", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)vssadmin"), "02 Ransomware", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)wmic"), "03 Lateral Movement", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)nslookup.*c2-checkin"), "14 C2 Beaconing", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)nslookup"), "04 Data Exfiltration", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)certutil.*urlcache"), "05 Phishing Attack", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)mshta|rundll32|regsvr32"), "06 LOLBin Execution", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)CurrentVersion\\\\Run"), "07 Registry Persistence", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)DisableRealtimeMonitoring|advfirewall"), "08 AV Firewall Tampering", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)lsass"), "09 Credential Dumping", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)setspn|Rubeus|KerberosRequestorSecurityToken"), "11 Kerberoasting", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachine"), "12 Scheduled Task Persistence", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)Get-Clipboard|CopyFromScreen"), "13 Clipboard Screen Capture", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)checkin"), "14 C2 Beaconing", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)CreationTime.*LastWriteTime"), "15 Timestomping", 1=1, null()) | where isnotnull(scenario) | stats dc(scenario) as unique_scenarios

html.p: Severity is assigned per Incident Report (not a native Splunk field) — see Incident-Reports/ for full justification per scenario.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 NOT (Process_Command_Line="*PcaSvc.dll*" OR Process_Command_Line="*AppXDeploymentExtensions*" OR Process_Command_Line="*SHCreateLocalServerRunDll*") | eval scenario=case( match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)insider"), "01 Insider Threat", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)vssadmin"), "02 Ransomware", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)wmic"), "03 Lateral Movement", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)certutil.*urlcache"), "05 Phishing Attack", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)mshta|rundll32|regsvr32"), "06 LOLBin Execution", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)CurrentVersion\\\\Run"), "07 Registry Persistence", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)DisableRealtimeMonitoring|advfirewall"), "08 AV Firewall Tampering", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)lsass"), "09 Credential Dumping", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)setspn|Rubeus|KerberosRequestorSecurityToken"), "11 Kerberoasting", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachine"), "12 Scheduled Task Persistence", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)Get-Clipboard|CopyFromScreen"), "13 Clipboard Screen Capture", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)nslookup.*c2-checkin|checkin"), "14 C2 Beaconing", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)CreationTime.*LastWriteTime"), "15 Timestomping", 1=1, null()) | where isnotnull(scenario) | stats count by scenario | sort scenario

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 NOT (Process_Command_Line="*PcaSvc.dll*" OR Process_Command_Line="*AppXDeploymentExtensions*" OR Process_Command_Line="*SHCreateLocalServerRunDll*") | eval tactic=case( match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)insider|certutil.*urlcache"), "Initial Access", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)mshta|rundll32|regsvr32"), "Execution", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)CurrentVersion\\\\Run|MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachine"), "Persistence", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)vssadmin|DisableRealtimeMonitoring|advfirewall|CreationTime.*LastWriteTime"), "Defense Evasion", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)lsass|setspn|Rubeus|KerberosRequestorSecurityToken"), "Credential Access", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)wmic"), "Lateral Movement", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)Get-Clipboard|CopyFromScreen"), "Collection", match(Process_Command_Line, "(?i)nslookup|checkin"), "Command and Control", 1=1, null()) | where isnotnull(tactic) | stats count by tactic

html.p: Excludes confirmed-legitimate rundll32.exe background noise (PcaSvc.dll, AppXDeploymentExtensions, SHCreateLocalServerRunDll COM activation) per Scenario 06 findings and dashboard-build observation.
